column1: obtained in Homoeopathy after following a
course of study of  not less than four years
duration including a period of internship  of
not  less  than  six  months,  granted  by  a
institution  affiliated  to  a  University  in
Sri Lanka  or abroad and which is recognized
by the Council having regard to the standard
of medical education of such medical college
or  institution,  including  such  other  criteria
as may be determined by the Council.
